verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions JDBC or ODBC drivers, or any documented BI-tool integration such as dashboard connectors. The closest items are a generic docs line about 'applications and tools that you can use to access Snowflake' and a REST SQL API, which are neither standard drivers nor BI integrations. In-product Snowsight visualization is not a third-party BI connection. The axis clearly applies to a data warehouse, so the absence of evidence yields 'none'.
